# Android
> Official Android product site covering Android phones, devices, features, safety, accessibility, enterprise, and developer resources.

Android.com explains the Android platform for consumers and businesses, with product overviews, feature guides, ecosystem information, and links to official support and developer documentation.

## Platform Overview
- [Android homepage](https://www.android.com/): Main entry point for Android phones, devices, features, and ecosystem information.
- [Android 15](https://www.android.com/android-15/): Overview of Android 15 features, privacy improvements, and platform enhancements.
- [Android versions](https://www.android.com/intl/en_us/versions/): Historical overview of Android releases and major platform changes.
- [Android phones](https://www.android.com/phones/): Explore Android phone capabilities, device experiences, and ecosystem benefits.
- [Android tablets](https://www.android.com/tablets/): Overview of Android tablet experiences, productivity, entertainment, and device flexibility.
- [Android ecosystem](https://www.android.com/ecosystem/): Summary of how Android devices and services work together across categories.

## Devices and Categories
- [Phones](https://www.android.com/phones/): Consumer-facing overview of Android phones and what they can do.
- [Tablets](https://www.android.com/tablets/): Android tablet category page with use cases and platform benefits.
- [Wear OS](https://www.android.com/wear/): Smartwatch experiences and Android integration through Wear OS devices.
- [TV](https://www.android.com/tv/): Android TV and Google TV experiences for streaming and home entertainment.
- [Auto](https://www.android.com/auto/): Android Auto overview for navigation, communication, and media in the car.
- [Quick Share](https://www.android.com/better-together/quick-share-app/): Cross-device file sharing experience for Android and compatible platforms.

## Features and Experiences
- [Google apps on Android](https://www.android.com/google-apps/): Overview of core Google apps and services available on Android.
- [Messages](https://www.android.com/google-apps/messages/): Android messaging experience with modern chat and communication features.
- [Photos](https://www.android.com/google-apps/photos/): Photo storage, organization, and sharing experience on Android devices.
- [Gboard](https://www.android.com/google-apps/gboard/): Keyboard features including typing, voice input, and multilingual support.
- [Google Meet](https://www.android.com/google-apps/meet/): Video calling and collaboration features available on Android.
- [Quick Share](https://www.android.com/better-together/quick-share-app/): Nearby file sharing across supported Android and PC devices.

## Safety, Privacy, and Security
- [Android safety](https://www.android.com/safety/): Central overview of Android security, privacy, and user protection features.
- [Security features](https://www.android.com/safety/security/): Device and platform security protections built into Android.
- [Privacy features](https://www.android.com/safety/privacy/): Privacy controls and transparency tools for Android users.
- [Find My Device](https://www.android.com/safety/find-my-device/): Device location, securing, and recovery features for lost hardware.
- [Google Play Protect](https://www.android.com/safety/google-play-protect/): App scanning and malware protection for Android devices.
- [Security updates](https://www.android.com/safety/security-updates/): Information about Android security patches and update practices.

## Accessibility
- [Accessibility overview](https://www.android.com/accessibility/): Overview of Android accessibility tools and inclusive design features.
- [Vision accessibility](https://www.android.com/accessibility/vision/): Features supporting blind and low-vision Android users.
- [Hearing accessibility](https://www.android.com/accessibility/hearing/): Accessibility tools for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
- [Mobility accessibility](https://www.android.com/accessibility/mobility/): Features helping users navigate Android with limited dexterity.
- [Cognitive accessibility](https://www.android.com/accessibility/cognitive/): Tools that simplify interaction and improve usability for diverse needs.
- [Accessibility Help](https://support.google.com/accessibility/android/): Official support resources for Android accessibility features.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Android Enterprise](https://www.android.com/enterprise/): Android management, security, and deployment information for organizations.
- [Android Enterprise devices](https://www.android.com/enterprise/devices/): Device catalog and recommendations for enterprise deployments.
- [Recommended program](https://www.android.com/enterprise/recommended/): Enterprise Recommended devices and solutions meeting Google criteria.
- [Work profile](https://www.android.com/enterprise/work-profile/): Separation of personal and work data on Android devices.
- [Zero-touch enrollment](https://www.android.com/enterprise/zero-touch/): Streamlined large-scale Android device provisioning for businesses.
- [Android Enterprise Help Center](https://support.google.com/work/android/): Support documentation for enterprise Android deployment and management.

## Help and Support
- [Android Help Center](https://support.google.com/android/): Official support hub for Android setup, troubleshooting, and device usage.
- [Android Community](https://support.google.com/android/community): Community forum for Android questions and peer support.
- [Find My Device Help](https://support.google.com/android/answer/6160491): Help article for locating, locking, or erasing Android devices.
- [Google Play Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/): Support for apps, purchases, subscriptions, and Play Store issues.
- [Pixel Phone Help](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/): Official support for Google Pixel phones and related features.
- [Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Google Account support relevant to Android sign-in and security.

## Developers
- [Android Developers](https://developer.android.com/): Official Android developer portal for building apps across device types.
- [Developer guides](https://developer.android.com/guide): Core Android app development guides and platform best practices.
- [API reference](https://developer.android.com/reference): Android framework API reference documentation.
- [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio): Official IDE for Android app development and testing.
- [Jetpack](https://developer.android.com/jetpack): Libraries, architecture guidance, and tools for modern Android development.
- [Training courses](https://developer.android.com/courses): Learning resources for Android development fundamentals and advanced topics.
- [Android Developers Blog](https://android-developers.googleblog.com/): Product updates, release notes, and technical announcements for developers.

## Open Source and Project Resources
- [Android Open Source Project](https://source.android.com/): Technical documentation for building and customizing the Android platform.
- [AOSP docs](https://source.android.com/docs): Documentation for Android platform architecture, builds, and compatibility.
- [Compatibility Definition](https://source.android.com/docs/compatibility/cdd): Requirements for device compatibility with the Android ecosystem.
- [CTS](https://source.android.com/docs/compatibility/cts): Compatibility Test Suite documentation for Android device validation.
- [Security on AOSP](https://source.android.com/docs/security): Platform security architecture and implementation guidance.
- [Source code](https://source.android.com/source): Access points and guidance for Android source code usage.
